g.text: Interactive editor application for browsing, validating,
rendering, and editing Aurora models with trust gating.
A trust-gated Rust backend exposing model discovery, snapshot
loading, validation, rendering, exports, and card CRUD
The overall Aurora system: schemas + canonical registries +
model cards, supported by tools (CLI/editor/shared library)
that validate models and generate views and exports.
The interface contract between the editor UI and the Tauri
validate/render/compact commands to users and pipelines.
Shared Rust library providing registry-aware parsing,
validation helpers, and rendering primitives used by Aurora
The editor’s frontend UI that calls the backend API, displays
validation diagnostics, and provides interactive navigation
Command-line tooling for validating Aurora models, generating
